description: Vue template listeners are native listeners at their elements, added when Vue creates the element (IR schedule.elementListeners): listeners script adds after mount run after them at the same element and phase, in registration order, capture listeners at the target before its bubble listeners; stopPropagation in a script listener below an element keeps that element template listeners from running, and stopImmediatePropagation in a template listener keeps the script listeners of the element from running; nested dispatches from a listener (dispatchEvent of a MouseEvent, requestSubmit) follow the same order, and a microtask a listener queues runs after that listener. A capture listener that stops propagation keeps the bubbling-phase listeners of its own element from running, here at an ancestor (the fixture's mode-capture-stop button), as in Chromium (the DOM standard's invocation per node and phase).
